faq.question: How long does merchant approval take?
faq.answer: Most merchant applications are reviewed within 24–48 business hours. You will receive an email when your store is approved and goes live to customers.

faq.question: When can I withdraw my earnings?
faq.answer: Earnings move from 'pending' to 'available' once an order is settled (delivered + payment captured). You can request a withdrawal from the Earnings page any time after that.

faq.question: How is the platform commission calculated?
faq.answer: Commission is a percentage of the order subtotal, configured by the platform. The rate that applies to your store appears on the Earnings page and any changes are logged in your commission history.

faq.question: How do I open or close my store temporarily?
faq.answer: Go to Settings → toggle 'Store is open'. While closed, customers cannot place new orders but in-flight orders continue.

faq.question: How do I mark an item as out of stock?
faq.answer: Open the item in the Menu page and toggle 'Available'. You can also flip whole variants on or off without removing the parent product.

faq.question: What happens when a customer raises a dispute?
faq.answer: You'll get a notification and the dispute appears in the Disputes tab. You can post messages explaining your side. The platform admin makes the final ruling; if a refund is issued, the amount is taken from the order's settlement.

articles.title: Setting up your storefront for the first time
articles.summary: Add your logo, cover image, opening hours, and your first three products. Customers see the product image first — invest in good photos.

articles.title: Menu best practices: variants, options, and pack sizes
articles.summary: Use variants for SKU-level differences (size, colour). Use option groups for add-ons that don't change the SKU (sides, spice level).

articles.title: How payouts work end-to-end
articles.summary: Order is paid → escrow → delivered → settled → available. Withdrawals are processed within 1–2 business days once approved.
